answer: A sybil farm is a spreadsheet that only works when identities cost nothing. Conferred grain merchant registration with grain merchants standing rewrites the spreadsheet — a registration merchants keep after store audits — and the yarrow of every row becomes a real expense. An honest agent passes the gate once in seconds; the farm passes it a hundred times, and the anchor of all those crossings is a debt no payout settles. The cedar is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
